items.title: More banks says customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
items.summary: Citi is the latest major financial institution to put the breaks on personal finance AI agents.
items.creator: Tim Fernholz

items.title: David Ellison says HBO will air critical Elon Musk documentary despite $1B investment in Skydance
items.summary: Following news of the investment, questions emerged over how Musk's sizable stake in the company might affect Skydance's plans to distribute a documentary that is highly critical of him.
items.creator: Aisha Malik
